feed_title: Orthopaedic Dog Bed Mattress, Brown Herringbone Tweed with Faux Fur Top, Foam Core, Leather Handles, Medium and Large | PawLunova Patterdale
descriptionHtml:
Brown tweed and leather. A foam core underneath. Both at once.

Patterdale is an open orthopaedic foam dog mattress in brown herringbone tweed with a faux-fur surface, in Medium and Large. The cover is machine washable.

You have probably had this argument with yourself already. The bed that suits the room is a thin pad in a nice fabric. The one with real foam in it arrives in grey ripstop and ends up behind a chair.

Patterdale is built to survive the room rather than be hidden from it. Brown herringbone tweed and leather carry handles outside. A foam core and a faux-fur sleeping surface inside.

What they get

  • An open mattress: No walls to climb, so they flop on from any direction and stretch full length.
  • Faux fur to lie on: A soft sleeping surface over a foam core.
  • Tweed and leather: A brown herringbone body with leather carry handles, so moving it takes one hand.
  • Practical underneath: A non-slip base, and a cover that comes off for the machine.

Best for: Dogs who stretch out full length, and rooms where the bed gets looked at nightly.

Why it is worth the money

£79 for the Medium and £119 for the Large is a cover decision as much as a bed decision. The cover is what you look at daily and wash monthly, and it goes shabby first. Tweed, faux fur and leather handles cost more and last longer than printed polyester with a plastic grab loop, and there is still a foam core underneath. And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

We do not hold centimetre measurements for Patterdale and we will not invent any. Sizes are set against breeds instead, which is blunter than a tape measure, so ask us if your dog sits between the two.

Size and fit

SizeListed as suiting
MediumSpringer Spaniel, Cockapoo, Staffordshire Bull Terrier
LargeGolden Retriever, Labrador, German Shepherd

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. The leather handles have their own care instructions. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Go by the breeds each size is listed against, and ask us if yours falls between.

Why are no centimetres listed?

Because we do not have them published. Rather than guess, we size it by breed.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

The build is an open foam mattress with no walls and a base that stays put. Put the question to your vet before ordering.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover is removable and machine washable to the sewn-in label. Leather is cared for separately.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Choose their size. It can stay in the living room.
